title: Assess shared helpers needed by rescue ISO
description: Review nix-lib builders and module utilities for reusable support needed by bootstrap identity, target selection, or ISO composition; add helpers only if they reduce duplication without hiding boot-stage behavior.

title: gatewatch: protected constitution change lacks explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit d60d7a8a4ce24a7ecb7bbebed26e21f5a5f30834, file docs/CONSTITUTION.md (new file; lines 1-142). Article IX requires changes to the constitution to receive explicit human review and not ride auto-merge. The merged history contains no seed tracker reference or explicit human sign-off for this protected change; the commit is authored by Roger Navelsaker but authorship alone is not the required sign-off evidence.
